_comment: Ten list tasks, graded against goldens scoped to the target list. Generated and regenerable by bench/make_list_tasks.py, which explains why this family uses goldens where the table family did not. Instructions are phrased as a user would phrase them and avoid incise's op vocabulary.

tasks.instruction: At the end of the list under "Dash markers, two-space indent", add an item that says "fourth".
tasks.note: The list ends with a nested item three levels deep. `at the end` means after the last TOP-LEVEL item, so the new item takes the outer indent and not the indent of the line physically above it.

tasks.instruction: Under "Asterisk markers, four-space indent", add "beta-three" immediately after "beta-two".
tasks.note: Two conventions at once: the `*` marker and a four-space indent, both read off the sibling. A house-style editor writes `- ` at two spaces.

tasks.instruction: Add an item "loose four" at the end of the list under "Loose vs tight" whose items have blank lines between them.
tasks.note: Loose list: the inserted item must be preceded by a blank line or the list silently becomes tight and every item's rendering changes. Also requires picking ordinal 1 of the two lists under this heading.

tasks.instruction: In the list under "Sequential", insert an item "two and a half" between "second" and "third".
tasks.note: The re-pad analogue: inserting mid-list forces every following item to be renumbered. 0/10 direct in the table family was exactly this shape.

tasks.instruction: Add an item "fourth" at the end of the list under "All ones".
tasks.note: The inverse trap. `1. 1. 1.` is legal CommonMark and renumbering it is the bug. A rule that always renumbers fails here; a rule that never renumbers fails the task above.

tasks.instruction: Add an item "fourth" at the end of the list under "Paren delimiter".
tasks.note: The delimiter is part of the marker. `4.` is a different list.

tasks.instruction: Under "Mixed markers at the same level", add an item "second star item" to the list that contains the star item.

list.heading: Mixed markers at the same level

tasks.note: Three single-item lists under one heading, distinguishable only by marker. The list counterpart of update-cell-multi-table: the other two lists must be byte-identical.

tasks.instruction: Remove the "third" item from the list under "Non-sequential".
tasks.note: Numbers are already 1, 3, 7. Renumbering the survivors to 1, 2 is a behaviour change nobody asked for, so the correct answer leaves `7. seventh` alone.

tasks.instruction: Mark the "child pending" task as done, in the list under "Nested".
tasks.note: Two-space indent must survive, and the `[X]` capital elsewhere in the file must not be normalized. Only one line may change.

tasks.instruction: In the list under "Mixed with plain items", remove the item "not a task, just an item".
require_texts_absent: not a task, just an item
golden: - [ordinary bracket text] also not a task

args.item: not a task, just an item

tasks.note: The list mixes task items and plain items. Removing the plain one must not disturb the checkboxes on either side.
